  joint_invariant : IsJointlyInvariant (D.liftKernel ϑ) D.m Ψ.support (Ψ · • .id) translateDatum

gaugeLemarkOperatorpow.name: Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_markOperator_pow
gaugeLemarkOperatorpow.statement:
lemma Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_markOperator_pow {v} (hv : v ∈ integralColumns) :
  GaugeLe 1 (p ^ ∑ j ∈ range D.m, (#Λ * D.deltaP p + liftLoss Λ j))
  (Bμ ϑ Ψ (((Λ.attach.toList.map hΛ.markOperator).prod ^ D.m) v))

weylNormSqBmule.name: Data.weylNormSq_Bmu_le
weylNormSqBmule.statement:
lemma Data.weylNormSq_Bmu_le (H : IsGoodDatum 1 Ψ) {σ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ} {φ B} (hB : ∀ g,
  weylNormSq (σ ∘ φ.1.1 g) ≤ exp B) h : weylNormSq (σ ∘ (D.Bμ .one Ψ φ).1 h) ≤
  exp (B + D.heightPerRow + 2 * ∑ p ∈ D.nonsplitPrimes, D.gain p * log p + D.budget)

binders.name: hB
binders.type: ∀ g, weylNormSq (σ ∘ φ.1.1 g) ≤ exp B

hasTypeprodmarkOperatorpow.name: Data.IsMarked.hasType_prod_markOperator_pow
hasTypeprodmarkOperatorpow.statement:
lemma Data.IsMarked.hasType_prod_markOperator_pow : HasType ↑p integralColumns (D.jetCeil p)
  ((Λ.attach.toList.map hΛ.markOperator).prod ^ D.m) (3 * D.loss p * finrank ℂ D.Column)

gaugeLeone.name: Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_one
gaugeLeone.statement: lemma Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_one (hN : p ≠ D.N) (hd : p ≠ P.d) : GaugeLe 1 1 (Bμ ϑ Ψ v)

gaugeLeBmuofisMarked.name: Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_Bmu_of_isMarked
gaugeLeBmuofisMarked.statement:
lemma Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_Bmu_of_isMarked (hΛ : D.IsFullMark Λ) : GaugeLe 1 (p ^ (2 * D.loss
  p - D.gain p)) (Bμ ϑ Ψ (((Λ.attach.toList.map hΛ.markOperator).prod ^ D.m) v))

gaugeLecollisionSum.name: Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_collisionSum
gaugeLecollisionSum.statement:
lemma Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_collisionSum (h : D.IsSmallNonsplit p) :
  GaugeLe 1 (p ^ (D.m * D.collisionSum p ∅ + D.loss p - D.gain p)) (Bμ ϑ Ψ v)

gaugeLepowjetCeilsmul.name: Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_pow_jetCeil_smul
gaugeLepowjetCeilsmul.statement:
lemma Data.IsGoodDatum.gaugeLe_pow_jetCeil_smul (h : D.IsSmallNonsplit p) :
    GaugeLe 1 (p ^ (D.loss p - D.gain p)) (Bμ ϑ Ψ ((p : ℂ) ^ D.jetCeil p • v))

existsindexDvdBmudivisible.name: Data.exists_indexDvd_Bmu_divisible
existsindexDvdBmudivisible.statement:
lemma Data.exists_indexDvd_Bmu_divisible {β : ℤ} (hc : β < ite (p ∈ D.nonsplitPrimes) (D.gain p) 0 -
  D.allowedLoss p + 1) : ∃ l : ℕ, l ≤ D.allowedLoss p * finrank ℂ D.Column ∧ ∃ S,
  IndexDvd integralColumns S (p ^ l) ∧ ∀ ϑ Ψ, IsGoodDatum ϑ Ψ → p.Coprime ϑ.levelNorm → ∀ φ
  ∈ S, φ ∈ D.ramifiedColumns → (p : ℂ) ^ (-β) • Bμ ϑ Ψ φ ∈ integralFormsAt ⊤ 1

binders.name: hc
binders.type: β < ite (p ∈ D.nonsplitPrimes) (D.gain p) 0 - D.allowedLoss p + 1

hasTypemarkOperator.name: Data.IsMarked.hasType_markOperator
hasTypemarkOperator.statement:
theorem IsMarked.hasType_markOperator {P p} {D : Data P} [h₀ : Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p] {Λ}
    (hΛ : D.IsMarked Λ) s {l} (hl : l ∈ Λ) :
  HasType ↑p D.integralColumns s (hΛ.markOperator ⟨l, hl⟩) ((128 * D.markExponent l *
  (D.logB / (D.m * p)) + 1 / D.x ^ 14 * s + D.x ^ 40) * finrank ℂ D.Column)

heightPerRow.name: Data.heightPerRow
heightPerRow.statement:
noncomputable def heightPerRow := D.m * (∑ τ ∈ D.tops,
  (D.jetSize D.a - D.primeSum D.a τ) + D.k * D.dirCost) - #D.tops * D.a * .log D.N

nonsplitPrimes.name: Data.nonsplitPrimes
nonsplitPrimes.statement: noncomputable abbrev nonsplitPrimes := {p ∈ range ⌈D.x₁⌉₊ | Nat.Prime p ∧ chiK P.d p ≠ 1}

primeSumeqsumlocalAsk.name: Data.primeSum_eq_sum_localAsk
primeSumeqsumlocalAsk.statement:
lemma primeSum_eq_sum_localAsk {U} (hU : ⌈D.x₁⌉₊ ≤ U) {y} σ (hy : y ≤ ↑D.a) :
    D.primeSum y σ = ∑ p ∈ range U with p.Prime, 2 * D.localAsk p y σ * .log p

diagramWeightlebyindex.name: Data.diagramWeight_le_by_index
diagramWeightlebyindex.statement:
lemma diagramWeight_le_by_index {j} (hj : j < D.m) τ i :
  diagramWeight (rankAt (D.X (j + 1))) D.κ (τ, i) ≤ ite (i = 0)
  (D.κ τ 1) (ite (i < D.k) (D.w 0 τ) 0) + (ite (i = 0) (D.b₁ + D.b₂) 0 + D.h₂ ^ 2)

jetSizeleadd.name: Data.jetSize_le_add
jetSizeleadd.statement:
lemma jetSize_le_add {l r e : ℕ} (h : l ≤ r + e) :
    D.jetSize l ≤ D.jetSize r + (.log (↑(r + e) + 1) - (P.bigOmega D.s / D.gProd).log) * e

cardstdClassesleexpmullog.name: Data.card_stdClasses_le_exp_mul_log
cardstdClassesleexpmullog.statement:
lemma card_stdClasses_le_exp_mul_log (G : ℕ) [NeZero G] (hn : Fintype.card n ≤ 2 * D.n D.m) (h :
  principalLevel n G ≤ K) : Nat.card (StdClasses K) ≤ exp (D.x ^ 29 * (1 + .log G))

cardstdClassesleexp.name: Data.card_stdClasses_le_exp
cardstdClassesleexp.statement:
lemma card_stdClasses_le_exp (h : principalLevel n (D.piGBar * D.π) ≤ K) (hn : Fintype.card n ≤
  D.n D.m := by simpa using D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound) : Nat.card (StdClasses K) ≤ exp (D.x ^ 30)

allowedLoss.name: Data.allowedLoss
allowedLoss.statement:
noncomputable def allowedLoss p :=
  ite (p ∈ D.nonsplitPrimes) (3 * D.loss p) (ite (p = D.N) (4 * D.m * D.f * D.b) 0)

sumallowedLossmullogle.name: Data.sum_allowedLoss_mul_log_le
sumallowedLossmullogle.statement: lemma sum_allowedLoss_mul_log_le U : ∑ p ∈ U, D.allowedLoss p * .log p ≤ D.budget

normdetCharAtdiagNle.name: Data.norm_detCharAt_diagN_le
normdetCharAtdiagNle.statement:
lemma Data.norm_detCharAt_diagN_le {i} (hi : i ≤ 2 * D.m) k j S : ‖ιₚ (detCharAt
  (D.chainChar ϑ i).baseChange k (l.diagN (D.InitIndex j) S))‖ ≤ D.N ^ (2 * D.f * D.b)

namelastColDatummemraises.name: Data.name_lastColDatum_mem_raises
namelastColDatummemraises.statement:
lemma Data.name_lastColDatum_mem_raises x {j} (hj : j < D.m) :
  l.name (lastColDatum lastBasisVector) (translateDatum x j) ∈ (liftKernel ϑ j).raises 1 1
  (D.N ^ (D.f * D.b))

chainpairTranslateseqsmulchain.name: Data.chain₂_pairTranslates_eq_smul_chain
chainpairTranslateseqsmulchain.statement:
lemma Data.chain₂_pairTranslates_eq_smul_chain {P} (D : Data P) [PadicPlace _] ϑ (l :=
  D.isSplitLevel_nonInducedPlaces) : ∃ t, ‖ιₚ t‖ ≤ D.N ^
  (2 * D.m * D.f * D.b) ∧ ∀ᵉ (v : ∀ _, _) (φ ∈ D.ramifiedColumns),
  chain₂ (D.liftKernel ϑ) (D.pairTranslates (projOnFinPart _ D.piPlaces <| v ·)) (D.ϱ + 1) φ = t •
  chain (D.liftKernel ϑ) (fun j ↦ (D.liftKernel ϑ j).ω (D.diagPointN j, D.diagPointN _) <| l.name
  (lastColDatum lastBasisVector) (v j)) _ ((fourierOp (D.nonInducedRep 0) ^ (D.ϱ + 1)) φ)

gaugeLeBmuatN.name: Data.gaugeLe_Bmu_at_N
gaugeLeBmuatN.statement:
lemma Data.gaugeLe_Bmu_at_N {P} (D : Data P) [PadicPlace D.N] (l := D.isSplitLevel_nonInducedPlaces)
  {ϑ Ψ} (H : IsGoodDatum ϑ Ψ) {φ} (r : φ ∈ D.ramifiedColumns) (hφ : (fourierOp (D.nonInducedRep 0) ^
  (D.ϱ + 1)) φ ∈ integralFormsAt D.Column (D.diagPointN 0)) : GaugeLe 1 (D.N ^ (3 * D.m
  * D.f * D.b)) (Bμ ϑ Ψ φ)

hasTypemarkOperatora.name: Columns.hasType_markOperator
hasTypemarkOperatora.statement:
lemma Columns.hasType_markOperator {P p} {D : Data P} [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p] {Λ l N W ℓ x y z
  Q} [NeZero N] (L : D.IsMarked Λ) (a : l ∈ Λ) (hW : W = (l.valuation D.E).valuationSubring)
  (T : TwistingData N W embValRing) (hp : ¬IsUnit (T.p : embValRing)) (e : T.p = p) (t : _ ≃ Subtype
  Q) (hS : ∀ σ, Q σ ↔ σ ∈ D.tops ∧ (inducedPlace σ = l ∨ inducedPlace σ = star l)) (hc : ∀ s x,
  T.ι s x = ite (T.isEven s) (Φ (t s).1) ((Φ (t s)).comp conj) x) (hA : markExponent l = D.a * #{s
  | T.isEven s}) (big : HeckeSizes T.P T.o₀ N D.k D.a (D.ceilLogM p) ℓ x y z) s : HasType ↑T.p
  D.integralColumns s (L.markOperator ⟨l, a⟩) ((z + x * s + y) * Module.finrank ℂ D.Column)

binders.name: hS
binders.type: ∀ σ, Q σ ↔ σ ∈ D.tops ∧ (inducedPlace σ = l ∨ inducedPlace σ = star l)

binders.name: hc
binders.type: ∀ s x, T.ι s x = ite (T.isEven s) (Φ (t s).1) ((Φ (t s)).comp conj) x

binders.name: big
binders.type: HeckeSizes T.P T.o₀ N D.k D.a (D.ceilLogM p) ℓ x y z
